method: Todoist: 'ZZ probe' created via Quick Add typing 'ZZ probe tomorrow at 9:30am' (DATE-10) and 'ZZ probe 23 sep' (DATE-11); DATE-01 read across the whole Inbox list (existing overdue rows plus the two new fixtures) via div.task_content + [data-testid=due-date-control]. meologue: fixtures seeded through the store (taskStore.upsert / setDate), titled 'ZZ probe tomorrowTimed' (date=2026-09-14T09:30), 'ZZ probe in10' (date=2026-09-23), 'ZZ probe overdue' (date=2026-09-12), 'ZZ probe today' (date=2026-09-13); DATE-01 read from each row's date span + its child svg.

DATE-10.row: Row wording for a Date carrying a time -- task tomorrow at 9:30 AM
DATE-10.note: meologue no longer inserts the comma. Previously it read 'Tomorrow, 9:30 AM'; the format-task-date.ts ', h:mm a' suffix has been fixed to match Todoist's space-separated form exactly, including colour.

DATE-11.row: Row wording for a Date more than 6 days out -- task 10 days out (23 Sep)
DATE-11.note: meologue now orders day-then-month ('23 Sep'). Previously it read 'Sep 21' (month-then-day, and a different day since it was captured on 2026-09-11); the describeDay fallback's formatDay ordering has been fixed to match Todoist, including colour.

DATE-01.row: Does the date badge contain a calendar svg, on overdue AND future-dated rows -- and is the icon overdue-only?

overdueRowsSample.title: add split and splid both without fail EOD

DATE-01.note: This settles the open question: the icon is NOT overdue-only in either app. Both show the calendar svg on every DATED row (today, overdue, tomorrow-timed, far-future) and neither shows it on an undated row. Icon size matches (12x12 computed in both). Icon colour tracks the date-tone colour in both apps (icon recolors with the text: red/green/orange/grey). This is the fix -- meologue previously rendered no icon at all on any date badge.
